name: Roman Baroque
summary: A dramatic, theatrical style of architecture characterized by grandeur, movement, and emotional intensity.
description: Roman Baroque architecture features bold curves, elaborate facades, and dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, intended to inspire awe and reinforce the power of the Catholic Church. It emerged as a response to the Protestant Reformation, using visual splendor to communicate religious fervor.
